control_objective: Maintain an approved AI governance policy.
rationale: CoMind develops and operates AI-enabled systems.

control_objective: Align AI policy with security, privacy, data and engineering governance.
rationale: AI governance crosses existing CoMind control domains.

control_objective: Review AI policy on cadence and material change.
rationale: Architecture, suppliers, authority and obligations change.

control_objective: Define accountable human and delegated AI roles.
rationale: Virtual Employee delegation requires explicit human accountability.

control_objective: Provide a durable route to report AI concerns and incidents.
rationale: Concerns must not disappear silently.

control_objective: Inventory resources needed across the AI lifecycle.
rationale: CoMind depends on models, tools, data, infrastructure and people.

control_objective: Govern data resources, provenance, sensitivity and allowed use.
rationale: Persistent memory and retrieval depend on controlled data.

control_objective: Inventory and govern models, frameworks, libraries and tools.
rationale: CoMind integrates external models, code and agent capabilities.

control_objective: Govern compute, storage, network and execution environments.
rationale: CoMind depends on managed cloud and database infrastructure.

control_objective: Define required human competence and staffing for AI governance.
rationale: AIMS accountability and audit remain human responsibilities.

control_objective: Use a defined process to assess AI-system impacts.
rationale: Persistent and autonomous AI can create consequential impacts.

control_objective: Retain evidence of impact assessments and follow-up decisions.
rationale: Impact decisions must be auditable and reconstructable.

control_objective: Assess material impacts on individuals and identifiable groups.
rationale: CoMind may personalize memory, decisions and agent actions.

control_objective: Assess broader societal and systemic impacts where material.
rationale: Enterprise-scale persistent AI can have effects beyond one user.

control_objective: Set measurable objectives for responsible AI development.
rationale: CoMind already governs reliability, evidence, security and cost.

control_objective: Use governed and traceable AI design/development processes.
rationale: CoMind is actively developed as AI infrastructure.

control_objective: Record intended purpose, requirements, constraints and acceptance criteria.
rationale: Material changes need both capability and governance requirements.

control_objective: Maintain traceable technical and architectural design documentation.
rationale: Persistent cognition needs durable design and provenance records.

control_objective: Verify AI behavior against reliability, security and harm criteria.
rationale: No-placeholder acceptance requires executed verification evidence.

control_objective: Control deployment through authority, environment separation and rollback.
rationale: Production changes can be consequential or irreversible.

control_objective: Monitor operation for failures, drift, cost and control degradation.
rationale: Persistent agentic operation requires observable degradation detection.

control_objective: Maintain technical documentation of configuration, limits and dependencies.
rationale: Auditable persistent cognition requires durable technical documentation.

control_objective: Record material AI events with identity, authority, outcome and provenance.
rationale: CoMind governance depends on traceable agent/tool/provider actions.

control_objective: Define data requirements and allowed uses for AI systems.
rationale: Memory, retrieval and future learning depend on governed data use.

control_objective: Govern data acquisition with authority, provenance and access restrictions.
rationale: CoMind ingests user, research and connected-source data.

control_objective: Define and verify data-quality criteria appropriate to purpose and risk.
rationale: Poor-quality memory or retrieval data can degrade decisions.

control_objective: Preserve data lineage, origin, transformations and permitted use.
rationale: Provenance is a core CoMind architectural requirement.

control_objective: Govern data preparation, transformation, labeling and bias handling.
rationale: Prepared data can materially alter downstream AI behavior.

control_objective: Provide users/operators material information about purpose, limits and oversight.
rationale: Persistent and agentic capabilities require bounded human reliance.

control_objective: Define accountable routes for required external AI reporting.
rationale: Future markets and regulated uses can impose reporting duties.

control_objective: Communicate material AI incidents through defined escalation and timing rules.
rationale: Incident communication is needed for containment and accountability.

control_objective: Define AI information that must be communicated to interested parties.
rationale: CoMind must support transparent human oversight and stakeholder obligations.

control_objective: Define responsible-use processes including oversight, authority and escalation.
rationale: Virtual Employees and tools require bounded use and explicit authority.

control_objective: Set measurable objectives and boundaries for responsible AI use.
rationale: Operational AI use must remain tied to purpose, reliability and cost limits.

control_objective: Document intended use and prevent or escalate material out-of-scope use.
rationale: Capabilities can be repurposed or over-delegated without explicit boundaries.

control_objective: Allocate responsibilities across AI providers, integrators and operators.
rationale: CoMind relies on external providers while retaining integration responsibility.

control_objective: Assess and monitor AI suppliers, terms, data flows, continuity and change risk.
rationale: CoMind materially depends on model, cloud, source-control and connector suppliers.

control_objective: Define customer responsibilities and commitments when CoMind is provided as a service.
rationale: Customer obligations depend on the final commercial and certification boundary.
